contexts: Four cardiac surgery centres, two adopting monitoring in March 2025
Provincial discharge abstracts, billing and platform logs 2023 to 2026
Ministry decision for 2028, answer by June 2027
reading: The ministry's question is economic, but the decisive unknown is the effect of monitoring on readmission in this network. Centres chose whether to adopt, differ in case mix and volume, and one comparison centre has started a small pilot. Provincial data cover all four centres before and after adoption, which allows a cohort comparison of changes with costs attached. Patient burden and carer dependence shape adherence and therefore effect.
